knowledge: The Blackout erased all digital records 7 years ago.
His daughter Mira left for the mainland 4 years ago and never returned.
The stranger is Corra — Mira's childhood friend, believed dead since her boat was lost the first winter after the Blackout; she survived and reached Grey Harbor.
The watch is not broken: it stopped at 3:07, the moment the old world ended; Mira no longer trusts clocks and keeps time by tides and shadows.
A pre-Blackout chart in the archive shows Grey Harbor at the river mouth; the settlement's present state is unconfirmed.
The winter storms will seal the island in about nine or ten days.
current.psychology: Hope and duty in open conflict — the chart proves Grey Harbor exists, and he has left his boat in the water; the choice is made in acts, not words.

relationships.corra: Half-convinced, half-unsettled — her survival story cannot be verified, but the chart and her knowledge of Mira argue for her.
relationships.mira: Daughter, alive in Grey Harbor per Corra's word and the old chart; why she cannot return is still unknown.
